item.tib: gtsug tor gdugs dkar gyi bzlog mdos chen mo mngon rtogs me dpung 'bar ba'i gur khang
item.coloph: zhes pa 'di yang gsang 'dus stag la'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i gsang sngags kyi nus ldan du gyur pa/ rang gi gcung po skam rigs kyi sngags 'chang khro rgyal bkra shis kyis yang yang bskul bar brten/ sman ri'i mkhan zur pa/ sgo btsun nyi ri shel bzhin gyis/ bru yi gnam mthong du brtsams pas/ 'di phyi'i rkyen dang bar chad thams cad bzlog par gyur cig/
